name: Switch-disconnector function qualifier
summary: This qualifier identifies combined switching and isolation in the associated representation.
description: This qualifier identifies combined switching and isolation in the associated representation. The combined function tells the reader that switching and isolation belong to the associated device representation. It does not add an overcurrent trip function.

When the SLD is expanded into a control schematic, retain the device tag and show any auxiliary contacts or operating mechanism separately. Protective devices elsewhere in the circuit remain separate items.
readingNotes: Read it with the complete power device and its operating-state information.
Switch-disconnector duty is different from automatic circuit-breaker interruption.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Read it with the complete power device and its operating-state information.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: Switch-disconnector duty is different from automatic circuit-breaker interruption.
